title: SatCompute active topology slice 0.2
description: One deterministic fixed-candidate topology-policy evaluation at an exact simulation time.

simulation_time_ns.description: Exact simulation time represented as signed 64-bit integer nanoseconds.

state_semantics.description: The slice evaluates orbit positions and topology policy at this trace time; it does not assert that the live network was reconfigured at this time.

candidate_link_count.description: Number of canonical fixed plus-grid candidates evaluated before distance gating.

active_link_count.description: Number of distance-gated active links in links.

links.description: Active links in canonical endpoint order; inactive fixed candidates are omitted.

candidate_kind.description: Whether the fixed candidate joins slots within a plane or corresponding slots across planes.

distance_m.description: Current raw ECEF endpoint separation in metres.

delay_ns.description: One-way propagation delay in integer nanoseconds after applying the configured fixed or distance mode.

link_bandwidth_bps.description: Configured full-duplex link bandwidth in bits per second.
